paragraphs.text: Walrus is a creature type for cards that depict large sea mammals known for their tusks, whiskers, and blubber that live in cold regions.

The type first appeared in Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate on Bronze Walrus which is an artifact creature . This is the only appearance, so far both as a type, on art, or in story. No Walrus has appeared in the actual Multiverse yet since its debut was in a Dungeons & Dragons set.
